description: One call: PDF invoice to parse (hallucination-guarded OCR) + field extraction + arithmetic verification (+optional issuer enrich). Flat $0.05/document; inputs validated before payment. Choose this when a PDF is an invoice/receipt and you want parse + field extraction + arithmetic verification in one paid call; for text only use parse_document.

enrich.description: Also run issuer enrichment on the parsed invoice

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the input (web page or PDF, per tool)

x_payment.description: Optional: base64 X-PAYMENT header value (x402 exact scheme, USDC on Base mainnet). Omit it to receive the payment requirements (accepts[] + docs) for this call without being charged.

name: document_pipeline

body.description: JSON body of the underlying call (see /samples/{product} for each product's shape)

status.description: HTTP status of the underlying call (200 result, 402 payment terms, 4xx input error)

title: Document Pipeline
